origin: New complete seed adaptation, written and edited by Codex under Martin Melcop Neto portfolio direction. Not restored, rewritten or canon-approved historical B01.
source_available: The original 0.1.0 story was written from the maintained P04 seed while historical manuscripts were unavailable. Ten main-book and eight OVA PDFs are now preserved separately. Revision 0.3.0 samples actual Book I physical pages 4–7, 116–119 and 137–141; it does not restore B01, reconcile the collection or establish authority. Original ZIP, editable manuscripts and authority policy remain unavailable.
retained_seed_elements: Aevren reconstructs older knowledge, rather than inventing all world systems
Darsen is cosmopolitan; nonhuman workers have practical agency
A small maintenance/intrusion incident can demonstrate a rule of the world
new_adaptation_choices: New Sava/Nera/Lesto/Eno/Tila, plot, waterworks and social arrangements. Broad Saelir hands are a local character detail, not an asserted historical species canon.

Corpse muscle requires contact/intact tissue; no resurrection, answering soul, healing of broken joints or remote worker intelligence. Aevren own embodied existence is assumed by the lich premise, not a new full cosmology.
Baldino remains alive and narrates witnessed events after the incident; no ghost/post-death knowledge. No fixed year or Aevren/Garran/Dorian identity equivalence.
Sava emergency permission to use the body is constrained, not portrayed as unpressured consent or forgiveness. Water cleanup, injuries, family testimony and pending accountability follow the rescue.

translation.translator: Codex, under Martin Melcop Neto portfolio direction; no independent translator or author ratification
translation.scope: All five revised scenes. Current PT and EN advance together to 0.3.0; earlier reading artifacts, fonts, stylesheet and format checker are preserved. The existing PDF producer now groups each scene’s closing paragraphs. No sequel or new cosmology.

glossary.Rua do Sal: Salt Street; translate this descriptive street name, retain Darsen and personal names.
glossary.registro: wash valve in the pipe passage; maintenance ledger/entry for signed records.
glossary.grade / grelha: hanging grille / outlet screen; distinguish the fatal corridor barrier from the blocked water outlet.
glossary.tomada / entrada / saída / descarga: intake / inlet / outlet / drain; the drain opens to the river and leaks back through the cracked wall.
glossary.comporta / freio / contrapeso: sluice gate / brake / counterweight; aligned chain must be released before the weight can fully fall and hold the gate open.
glossary.viga / alça: wooden beam/brace for improvised supports; iron operating lever / loop for the drain mechanism. Current source distinguishes both explicitly.
glossary.cabo: cable for the grille; handle in the wheel/brake context.
glossary.chave: wrench for Sava; house key for Tila; service key for Lesto.
glossary.saelir: retain source name/lowercase without inventing a species glossary.
glossary.intimação: summons; punishment and payment remain undecided.
glossary.cobrir Lesto: shroud Lesto, inferred from the final body-preparation scene; no burial place or additional rite introduced.

translation.editorial_interpretation: Revision 0.3.0 corrects the original Portuguese guard/beam wording to the action previously inferred by the English translator: Eno releases the beam and seizes the coat. Earlier source identity and translator choices remain in ENGLISH_RUN.json and Git history. The shrouding interpretation is retained.
translation.voice_and_continuity: Baldino remains self-excusing but names the false repair before the family; Aevren is practical/possessive, Sava technically decisive with constrained permission and grief, Nera terse about public water. Refusal initiates actual withdrawal before Sava reopens the plan. First-day cart supply, next-day testimony and pending accountability replace the earlier unmarked day-three jump; no resurrection or remote command.
translation.review: Whole PT/EN pair reviewed by Codex; five headings and 255 prose paragraphs correspond, and eight personal/place-name counts agree. These structural probes do not prove semantic fidelity or reader comprehension.

revision.editorial_scope: Existing rescue and aftermath; no archived-source changes. Refusal changes conduct, terms become explicit, machinery and chronology become clearer, final testimony includes fraud. Emergency pressure and the dangerous paper distraction remain.
revision.publisher_change: Keep the last three paragraphs of each scene together in PDF; previous editions remain unchanged.

publication_authorization.scope: Martin explicitly confirmed authority over the P04 texts and authorized publication of story.md, story.en.md and all four 0.3.0 EPUB/PDF editions. This records publication permission, not independent reader/translator or canon approval.
